sentences.text: The case diary produced has been perused.
It has been submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner is no way involved in this case as per the statement of the victim recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C.
He further submits that the petitioner was arrested only on suspicion.
He also stated that the petitioner was arrested on 02.05.2023 and he has been detained in custody till today.

Considering the background of the case,
the prayer of the petitioner may be considered.
Perused the case diary along with the statement of the victim recorded under section 164 Cr.P.C.

It reveals that the victim was accompanied with Lachit Das and Tridip Saikia to attend a Bihu function and subsequently, they took her in a vehicle towards a forest area and committed the offence as alleged.

The only allegation against the present petitioner is that he was in the said vehicle and nothing has been alleged by the victim in her statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C. regarding his involvement in the offence.
Mr. Gogoi, learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State submits that he has no objection if the prayer of the petitioner is allowed.
Considering the submissions made by the learned counsel for the parties as well as the materials available in the case diary, the prayer of the petitioner is allowed.

Accordingly, the accused-petitioner, named above, shall be released on bail in connection with the case Changsari Police Station Case No. 123/2023, on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- with a suitable surety of the like amount, to the satisfaction of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Kamrup,
Amingaon.
Return the case diary.
